platform.en: JAMAA (ja-MAA, Arabic for “the gang, the gathering”) is a party-games app for Android TV and Google TV: 3–12 players join from their phones by scanning a QR code, with nothing to install on phones. Its first game is Mish Ana!, a secret-word game.
platform.fr: JAMAA (prononcé « ja-MAA », « la bande » en arabe) est une appli de jeux d’ambiance pour Android TV et Google TV : de 3 à 12 joueurs rejoignent la partie avec leur téléphone en scannant un QR code, sans rien installer. Son premier jeu est Mish Ana!, un jeu du mot secret.
platform.ar: «جماعة» تطبيق ألعاب سهرة على Android TV و Google TV: من 3 لـ12 لاعب بيفوتوا من تلفوناتن بمسح كود QR، بلا ما ينزّلوا شي. أوّل لعبة فيه «مش أنا!»، لعبة الكلمة السرّية.
platform.es: JAMAA (se pronuncia «ya-MAA», «la pandilla» en árabe) es una app de juegos de fiesta para Android TV y Google TV: de 3 a 12 jugadores se unen con el móvil escaneando un código QR, sin instalar nada en los móviles. Su primer juego es Mish Ana!, un juego de palabra secreta.

definition.en: Mish Ana! is a secret-word party game for Android TV and Google TV: 3–12 players join from their phones by scanning a QR code, get the same secret word, and find the Mole: the one player with no word.
definition.fr: Mish Ana! est un jeu d’ambiance du mot secret pour Android TV et Google TV : de 3 à 12 joueurs rejoignent la partie avec leur téléphone en scannant un QR code, reçoivent le même mot secret et cherchent la Taupe, le seul joueur sans mot.
definition.ar: «مش أنا!» لعبة سهرات بالكلمة السرّية على Android TV و Google TV: من 3 لـ12 لاعب بيفوتوا من تلفوناتن بمسح كود QR، الكل بتوصلن نفس الكلمة السرّية، والهدف تكشفوا الجاسوس: اللاعب الوحيد اللي ما معو كلمة.
definition.es: Mish Ana! es un juego de fiesta de palabra secreta para Android TV y Google TV: de 3 a 12 jugadores se unen con el móvil escaneando un código QR, reciben la misma palabra secreta y buscan al Topo, el único jugador sin palabra.

facts: Name: JAMAA (Arabic: جماعة, said ja-MAA, "the gang, the gathering"), a party-games app for the TV. Game #1: Mish Ana! (Arabic: مش أنا!), Lebanese Arabic for "Not me!".
Genre: party games; game #1 (Mish Ana!) is a social deduction, secret-word / impostor word game.

Games: Mish Ana! (game #1, available now). Announced and not released yet: Bluff! (a bluffing game: write fake answers, find the true one), Most Likely ("who's most likely to…" voting about the people in the room) and Quiz Night (trivia, starting with a quiz about Lebanon). Upcoming game names may change. Every game is free to play.
Platforms: Android TV and Google TV app (Google Play package app.jamaa.tv), plus a browser version that runs on any laptop or smart-TV browser.
How it works: the TV shows a QR code; each player scans it and plays in their phone's web browser (iPhone or Android). Nothing to install on phones, no accounts, no controllers.
Players: 3 to 12, one phone each, in the same room.

Roles (default rule since 2026-10-07): Civilians share the same secret word; the Mole gets no word, only a "You're the Mole!" card, bluffs with vague clues, and if voted out gets one last guess at the word to steal the win. Optional extra role: the Undercover gets a slightly different word (e.g. PASTA vs PIZZA) and is not told; groups can add Undercovers or mix both roles.
Round: everyone gives one spoken clue, then everyone votes on their phone; the TV reveals the role of the player voted out.
Languages: English, French, Arabic (full right-to-left) and Spanish, with Lebanese word packs; 1,300+ word pairs for Mish Ana!.
Price: free to play; no ads, no accounts. An optional subscription, the JAMAA Pass, may later unlock extra packs for every game; it would only be sold on the TV, never on phones.
Privacy: players only type a nickname; rooms are deleted automatically.
Requires: internet on the TV and on every phone.
Does not run as an app on Samsung (Tizen), LG (webOS), Fire TV or Apple TV; owners of those TVs can use the browser version on a laptop connected by HDMI.

en.title: Mish Ana!, the Secret-Word Party Game for TV – JAMAA
en.description: Find the liar on your TV. JAMAA brings party games to Android TV & Google TV, starting with Mish Ana!: 3–12 players, phones are the controllers, free to play.
en.ogTitle: Mish Ana! on JAMAA – Everyone’s innocent. Someone’s lying.
en.ogDescription: JAMAA puts party games on your TV, starting with Mish Ana!, the secret-word game. Phones are the controllers: scan the QR, get your word, find the liar. 3–12 players, free to play.
en.ogImageAlt: Mish Ana! – Everyone’s innocent. Someone’s lying. A TV shows six phones: five say PIZZA, one says PASTA.

fr.title: Mish Ana!, le jeu du mot secret sur la télé – JAMAA
fr.description: Le jeu de soirée façon « qui est l’intrus » sur ta télé : de 3 à 12 joueurs, le téléphone sert de manette, rien à installer. Gratuit, Android TV et Google TV.
fr.ogTitle: Mish Ana! sur JAMAA – Tout le monde est innocent. Quelqu’un ment.
fr.ogDescription: JAMAA met les jeux d’ambiance sur ta télé, à commencer par Mish Ana!, le jeu du mot secret. Les téléphones servent de manettes : scanne le QR code, reçois ton mot, démasque le menteur. 3 à 12 joueurs, gratuit.

ar.ogTitle: «مش أنا!» على جماعة – كلّنا أبرياء… بس في حدا عم يكذب
ar.ogDescription: جماعة بتجيب ألعاب السهرة عتلفزيونك، وأوّلها «مش أنا!»، لعبة الكلمة السرّية. امسحوا كود QR، كل واحد بتوصلو كلمة عتلفونو، واكشفوا الكذّاب. من 3 لـ12 لاعب، ببلاش.
ar.ogImageAlt: مش أنا! – كلّنا أبرياء… بس في حدا عم يكذب. تلفزيون عليه ستّ تلفونات: خمسة مكتوب عليها بيتزا، وواحد برغر.

es.description: Descubre al mentiroso en tu tele. JAMAA lleva los juegos de fiesta a Android TV y Google TV, empezando por Mish Ana!: de 3 a 12 jugadores, el móvil es el mando, gratis.
es.ogTitle: Mish Ana! en JAMAA – Todos son inocentes. Alguien miente.
es.ogDescription: JAMAA pone juegos de fiesta en tu tele, empezando por Mish Ana!, el juego de la palabra secreta. Los móviles hacen de mando: escanea el QR, recibe tu palabra, descubre al mentiroso. De 3 a 12 jugadores, gratis.
